analysis.analysis: 'A speculative philosophical framework and systemic commentary tradition that revives the 8-step medieval scholastic method (textus, lectio, quaestio, objectiones, sed contra, respondeo). It evaluates canonical texts under the governing pressure of a contingent Omega, where the universe compresses into archives and the end goal depends on action.' Key Pillars: The Scholastic Method, Cosmological Omega (Teilhard de Chardin, 'mutual retrocausation of symbol and matter'), The Contingency Factor. SciLynk: Part One — Three Lectiones.
